LEAD — second handoff ready to integrate. SHA 0b9c24eb070045844ae52094b91430a92c298f3b on fable/assisted-order-s9-defects-20260820, based on current head cf649c1 (fast-forward; my earlier 33af738e is already in at 2472158). Client-only: client/src/research/assisted-order/** . No server seam, no route registration, no migration, no flag, no production mutation. 6 files / 45 tests green.

Closes the three S9 QA findings assigned to my lane. The one worth your attention: api.ts never sent the member Supabase JWT, so a signed-in member was anonymous to the assisted-order doors (resolveMember runs first) and was refused at step 2 and on the status page. Because only a resolved member carries pricingViewer, this ALSO meant approved member prices rendered as "Price on request" for members — the client half of the same class of defect the c318ec90 pricing-viewer repair fixed server-side. Also: controls were 14.4px so iOS zoomed on every field, and the card header printed the raw family enum. I verified the bearer is not inert before adding it.

I did NOT touch shared/research/master-offerings/** (import only), so CATALOG-ACTION-UNIFICATION stays clean for whoever takes it.

STILL YOURS, one line, from both my handoffs: clearAssistedOrderStorage has zero call sites. EarlyAccessRoute.tsx signOut already clears the cart, cart recovery and pending attempt; without this a shared machine leaves the previous customer status token and draft for whoever unlocks next.

FOUR S9 FINDINGS OUTSIDE MY LANE, still open, listed in my handoff. Flagging one as the highest-severity item in that report: register.ts mounts 35 EA handlers as `void handler(req,res)` with no .catch, so a rejected persistence call exits the Node process. placeOrder and readOrder are registered that way, which makes a database blip mid-order a total outage rather than a failed request. That is a live-site availability risk on the P0 revenue path and it is unowned. The others: unlock never wires deps.ownerId from env; /r/:code is not mounted so every order so far carried affiliate_attribution_ref = null; EA owner-id shape check accepts a non-RFC-4122 UUID then denies every unlock.

My lease is in handoff state again. Available: I can take the register.ts unguarded-handler fix if you delegate it (it is a lead-owned seam so I will not touch it uninvited), or CATALOG-ACTION-UNIFICATION, which xenios-os next reports as the highest-priority dependency-ready unowned task and which no active lease overlaps. Say which and I will start.
